purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Bohori

queries.query: Bohori Assam official cadastral map land records parcel map
queries.result: First-party Assam sources identify the state ILRMS land-record hub, Bhunaksha cadastral mapping viewer, Jamabandi land-record service, and Assam cadastral mapping program. First-party Barpeta district material identifies Chenga as a revenue circle and a current village-list route; the district's official site does not expose an open parcel polygon for Bohori in the bounded review.

queries.query: বহৰি অসম চৰকাৰ ভূমি মানচিত্ৰ জমিৰ নক্সা
queries.result: অসমীয়া discovery reached the same first-party Assam ILRMS/Bhunaksha/Jamabandi services. The official Bhunaksha village response uses Assamese labels and contains the Chenga circle; the official Barpeta Chenga revenue-village PDF lists Bahari and Niz Bahari, but no retained parcel geometry or safe native parcel identity was obtained.

registryEvidence.custodian: Government of Assam Revenue & Disaster Management Department / Directorate of Land Records, with Barpeta district administration and Chenga Revenue Circle local scope.
registryEvidence.locality: Bohori/Bohari, Barpeta district, Assam; official Barpeta material identifies Chenga as a revenue circle and lists Bahari/Niz Bahari in the Chenga revenue-village material.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: Local administrative custody and a current public cadastral viewer are evidenced. The Bohori queue point is preserved exactly; the evidence does not establish citywide open parcel geometry completeness.

officialSources.observation: Official Barpeta district page defines revenue villages and lists Chenga among the six revenue circles.
Official Chenga revenue-circle PDF lists 72 revenue villages, including Niz Bahari and Bahari.
Official Assam ILRMS hub links Bhunaksha as cadastral mapping software and Jamabandi as the public land-record service.
Current first-party Bhunaksha viewer JavaScript was inspected; it uses public backend routes for district/circle/village discovery and parcel display.
Official Assam Science Technology and Environment Council page describes Assam cadastral maps under the SIS-DP project.

parcelDiscovery.source: Assam Bhunaksha / ILRMS official cadastral lead
parcelDiscovery.crs: EPSG:32646 is specified by the current Bhunaksha client for parcel_info requests; no returned geometry was obtained to validate it for this city.
parcelDiscovery.boundedResponse: The public Bhunaksha district endpoint returned district codes; POST circle discovery for Assam code 05 returned Barpeta and POST village discovery for circle 050106 returned the Chenga village list. The client configuration exposes POST /bhunakshaBackEnd/proxy/parcel_info with village_code, layer_code=ASSAM_PARCEL, dag_no, and crs=32646, plus a WMS route. No dag number was guessed or used, and no parcel_info geometry response was retained.
parcelDiscovery.note: No usable anonymous parcel identity-plus-geometry response was obtained. The exact WUP point was preserved and was not used as an absence test.
